dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 9742 IH: Extension of Department of Veterans Affairs Expiring Authorities Act of 2024
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mrs. Sykes (for herself, Mr. Takano, Ms. Kaptur, Ms. Caraveo, Mr. Cartwright, Mr. Mrvan, Ms. Perez, and Ms. Budzinski) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs, and in addition to the Committee on Armed Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to extend certain expiring provisions of law, and for other purposes.

section.header: Short title
section.text: This Act may be cited as the Extension of Department of Veterans Affairs Expiring Authorities Act of 2024.

section.header: Extension of authority for collection of copayments for hospital care and nursing home care
section.text: Section 1710(f)(2)(B) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of requirement to provide nursing home care to certain veterans with service-connected disabilities
section.text: Section 1710A(d) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of expansion of rural access network for growth enhancement program of the Department of Veterans Affairs
section.text: Section 2(d) of the Sgt. Ketchum Rural Veterans Mental Health Act of 2021 (Public Law 117–21; 38 U.S.C. 1712A note) is amended by striking 2024 and inserting 2025.

section.header: Extension of pilot program to provide veterans access to complementary and integrative health programs through animal therapy, agritherapy, sports and recreation therapy, art therapy, and posttraumatic growth programs
section.text: Section 203(d)(1) of the Scott Hannon Veterans Mental Health Care Improvement Act of 2019 (Public Law 116–171; 38 U.S.C. 1712A note) is amended by striking for a three-year period beginning on the commencement of the pilot program and inserting until September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority for joint Department of Defense-Department of Veterans Affairs medical facility demonstration fund
section.text: Section 1704(e) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2010 (Public Law 111–84; 123 Stat. 2573), as most recently amended by section 104 of division E of the Continuing Appropriations and Ukraine Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2023 (Public Law 117–180; 136 Stat. 2137), is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of entitlement to memorial headstones and markers for commemoration of veterans and certain individuals
section.text: Section 2306(b)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking October 1, 2024 both places it appears and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority to bury remains of certain spouses and children in national cemeteries
section.text: Section 2402(a)(5) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking October 1, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Authority for use of flat grave markers at Santa Fe National Cemetery, New Mexico
section.text: Section 2404(c)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (D), by striking ; and and inserting a period at the end;
in subparagraph (E), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: in the case of Santa Fe National Cemetery, New Mexico, the Secretary may provide for flat grave markers in any section of such cemetery in which flat markers were in use on December 22, 2023.

section.header: Extension of authority to provide assistance for specially adapted housing for disabled veterans residing temporarily in housing owned by a family member
section.text: Section 2102A(e) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking December 31, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority for specially adapted housing assistive technology grant program
section.text: Section 2108(g) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of authorization of appropriations for homeless women veterans and homeless veterans with children reintegration grant program
section.text: Section 2021A(f)(1) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 2024 and inserting 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority for treatment and rehabilitation for seriously mentally ill and homeless veterans

subsection.text: Section 2031(b) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.
Section 2033(d) of such title is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of funding for financial assistance for supportive services for very low-income veteran families in permanent housing

subsection.text: Section 2044(e)(H) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 2024 and inserting 2025.
Section 2044(e) of such title is amended by redesignating subparagraphs (A) through (H) as paragraphs (1) through (8), respectively.

section.header: Extension of funding for grant program for homeless veterans with special needs
section.text: Section 2061(d)(1) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 2024 and inserting 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority to transport individuals to and from Department of Veterans Affairs facilities
section.text: Section 111A(a)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of testimonial subpoena authority of Inspector General of the Department of Veterans Affairs
section.text: Section 312(d)(7)(A) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking May 31, 2025 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of authority to maintain regional office in the Republic of the Philippines
section.text: Section 315(b) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension and modification of authority for monthly assistance allowance for disabled veterans training in Paralympic and Olympic sports program
section.text: Section 322 of title 38, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking the United States Olympic Committee each place it appears and inserting the United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee;
in subsection (a), by striking Veterans Benefits Administration and inserting Veterans Health Administration; and
in subsection (d), by amending paragraph (4) to read as follows:
There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subsection the following:

subparagraph.text: For each of fiscal years 2010 through 2023, $2,000,000.
For each of fiscal years 2024 through 2027, $2,500,000.

section.header: Extension of authority for report on equitable relief provided due to administrative error
section.text: Section 503(c) of title 38, United States Code, is amended, in the second sentence, by striking December 31, 2024 and inserting December 31, 2025.

section.header: Modification of certain housing loan fees
section.text: The loan fee table in section 3729(b)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking November 15, 2031 each place it appears and inserting November 29, 2031.

section.header: Extension of authority for transfer of real property
section.text: Section 8118(a)(5) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking September 30, 2024 and inserting September 30, 2025.

section.header: Extension of requirements relating to Chief Financial Officer of the Department
section.text: Section 7103 of the Johnny Isakson and David P. Roe, M.D. Veterans Health Care and Benefits Improvement Act of 2020 (Public Law 116–315) is amended by striking for fiscal year 2022 and each of the next three subsequent fiscal years and inserting for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2029.
